rationale: The exchange has become more structured and evidence-based, but the core conflict remains unresolved: labor and the state still reject closures and forced redundancies, while management, owners, and investors still require proven structural capacity and cost reduction. Round 3 sharpened positions and requested models, but no side has substantively bridged the central incompatibility, so further unassisted rounds are likely to repeat the same red lines unless an external factual intervention or model is introduced.
